The '''Imperial Civil Service''' was an organization within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
It was staffed by civilian [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]] who assisted the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. [[Adana Vermor]] was a civilian [[Imperial Economics Advisor|Economics Advisor]] working within the [[Imperial Office of Logistics]], advising the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] on matters of economics and logistics.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
